typeLabels.structured_planner: You thrive on structure. Stick to the standard {work}min focus / {break}min break routine.
typeLabels.deep_diver: You have high stamina. Go deep for {work}mins, then completely disconnect for {break}mins.
typeLabels.rhythmic_sprinter: Short and punchy! The {work}min sprint (Pomodoro) beats your procrastination.
typeLabels.creative_explorer: Don't interrupt the flow. Explore for {work}mins, then let your mind wander for {break}mins.
typeLabels.flexible_adapter: Stay flexible. {work}mins is your baseline, but switch to a {break}min break if you lose flow.
typeLabels.social_collaborator: You thrive on connection. Focus for {work}mins with a body-double or co-working video, then chat for {break}mins.
